answer: An operator running 208 keys therefore pays for 208 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the jade quota and the walnut admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 5 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the cedar ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
